discourse.title: Love Is God, Live In Love
discourse.excerpt: What is Love? What is its nature? From where does it originate? Can a human being live without love? Impossible. That is why, it is said, "Love is God; Live in Love". One has to understand this principle of Love, which is the basis for everything in this universe. Without Love, there cannot be life in this world.
discourse.theme: Love is God; live in love.

reflection: What is love, Swami asks — where does it come from? Can you live without it for even a day? You cannot, because love is not something you have; it is what you are. It is God Himself, pulsing through everything. So don't ration it. Love the difficult person, love the boring task, love the stranger — that is not sentiment, that is the highest sadhana. Live in love today, and you are living in God. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 36, 28 Oct 2003)

seva_nudge: Do one act of love with zero expectation — help a stranger, forgive a small debt, or write an encouraging note.
